posts.title: The bar got 11 paintings overnight.
posts.body: Codex spent the night painting El Segundo — golden hour, night with stars, marine-layer morning, storm rolling in, plus a Ghibli watercolor wildcard, plus close-ups of every kit building. Mood board at /bar-mood-board. Pick a direction and we apply it to the live bar this week.
